Original two-bed home visible, separate living/kitchen dining. Spacious/sparse; no new exact duplication after seven-home changes.
Bakery display/POS/seating and back prep/storage visible. Large free sales area; no new fit-out in this study.

Further all-floor reinspection catches new PRIMARY_BED180degree rotation placing headboard in front of actual bedroom entry. Guest bookcase on entry wall also overlaps door approach. FIX_REQUIRED; supersedes earlier no-obvious-collision pilot observation.
Added cafe right-hand upper seating close to espresso-bar left edge: chair pull-out appears severely restricted. Measure actual geometry and relocate whole table/chair set, not hide/crop it.
Reading lounge sofa directly below entry door, restricting entry approach. Shift sofa away from door; service/table rooms otherwise distinct.
Bookshop shelves/display/POS/back office/storage visible. Office desk chair near door merits clearance audit; no collision certified.
New180degree primary-bed rotation puts headboard by doorway; new art-reference case against entry-wall also intrudes entry approach. FIX_REQUIRED; desk/easel are real distinct functions.
Flower shop six planted displays, work counter/POS/back support rooms visible. Not empty; office-chair/door approach needs measurement as elsewhere.

New conservatory entry blocked by entry-wall potting bench. Whole living half-turn also places armchair/plant at kitchen approach. Keep safe original primary/living furniture positions except carefully isolated sofa/table variation. FIX_REQUIRED.
Clothing racks, folded display, sales/POS/back stock/office visible; different shop function. Near-final material/cutaway/interior inspection still needed.
Atelier/pattern offices furnished but very sparse: desks, one cutting table/rack/shelves. Enrich with actual use-specific sewing/cutting equipment, not relabel.
Hotel reception counter/storage, sofa/two angled armchairs, table and service rooms distinct. No obvious plan collision; not certified.
Existing LEFT guest-bedroom headboard blocks hall-door approach. Separate bedroom/salon/WC suites visible. Must move actual bed group away from entry.

VISUAL DUPLICATE of L02 hotel fit-out despite different numeric geometry hashes. Hash uniqueness is NOT usable aesthetic distinctness acceptance. Same left-bed entry obstruction. Refit this upper floor with genuinely different twin/family suites. FIX_REQUIRED.
Toy-shop perimeter displays/main toy island/POS/back workshop/stock visible. Distinct from other shops; low resolution insufficient product-quality inspection.
New child toy chest crosses room entry; primary-bed half-turn and living armchair/kitchen door also obstruct approaches. FIX_REQUIRED.
Three display vitrines and sales desk/back stock/office visible. Actual products/brand need eye-level check, not accepted from overhead.
Maker tools/bench distinct but parts-case intrudes room entry edge; living whole-turn armchair/kitchen obstruction. Primary-bed original orientation remains safer. FIX_REQUIRED.
Pharmacy/dispensing shelves and back consultation/stock visible; small consultation desk/chair crowded by entry and exam bed, clearance audit required.
Two real consulting/exam rooms with sinks/beds/desks/stools plus support/WC. Use-specific fit-out differs from atelier/reading floor, though sparse.
Six actual bike display arrangements plus sales/repair/stock visible; from overhead bikes are thin, need actual side/interior proof.
Cycle/gear room real bike/locker/service bench differs functionally; bench near entry and cross-room bicycle need safer orientation. Living whole-turn puts armchair near kitchen door. FIX_REQUIRED.
Stationery/book perimeter displays, three product islands, lockers/POS/back stock/office visible; actual products need interior inspection.
New entry-wall bookcases restrict study door; primary headboard at doorway due half-turn; living armchair kitchen approach also poor. FIX_REQUIRED.
